Moblins carrying these in battle are particularly dangerous.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 45 |durability = 24 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Dragonbone Moblin Club}} Dragonbone Moblin Clubs are two-handed [[Weapon]]s wielded by [[Enemy|Enemies]] such as [[Black Moblin]]s, [[Silver Moblin]]s, [[Golden Moblin]]s, and [[Stalmoblin]]s. They are [[Moblin Club]]s that have had ancient bones attached to them the make them more damaging in battle. They are commonly found in the [[Hebra Mountains]] and [[Eldin Mountains]]. Dragonbone Moblin Clubs belong to the [[Moblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of Weapons crafted by [[Moblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Dragonbone Moblin Clubs are not made out of metal, therefore equipping one will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. They are made of wood, however, and will consequently catch [[Fire]] when exposed to open flame or equipped in the [[Scorching Climate]] of [[Death Mountain]]. They will also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but the are unable to be picked up by the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_012" |Life = 24 |Power = 45 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 10 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 38 |BuyingPrice = 99 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Dragonbone Moblin Club Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Dragonbone Moblin Club ==See Also== {{See Also| * Moblin Club * Moblin Gear * Spiked Moblin Club * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Clubs, Moblin Gear, Weapons, Two-Handed Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
